strain.Description: Mouse strain or strains, from the lab's dataset card.

genotype.Description: Genotype as the lab reports it, pending their confirmation with the experimenters.

sex.Description: n/a, since a subject here is more than one animal.

male_id.Description: Animal ID of the male of the pair.

female_id.Description: Animal ID of the female of the pair.

male_age.Description: Age of the male. n/a until the lab supplies birth dates.

female_age.Description: Age of the female. n/a until the lab supplies birth dates.
